definitions.explanation: A document created by a private individual or organization, as opposed to an official or public document issued by a government body. In legal contexts, this distinction is important because forging private documents and public documents carry different penalties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{私文書|しぶんしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}される→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧。
examples.english: Contracts are classified as private documents.

examples.japanese: {私文書|しぶんしょ}⟦{偽造|ぎぞう}→偽造：11524_gizou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Forging a private document is a crime.

examples.japanese: {私文書|しぶんしょ}であって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧や⟦{押印|おういん}→押印：07488_ouin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{法的|ほうてき}→法的：13300_houteki⟧な⟦{効力|こうりょく}→効力：11824_kouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even a private document can have legal validity if it bears a signature or seal.

notes:
Compound of {私|し} (private; personal) and ⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧ (document). The reading ⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧ becomes しぶんしょ as a compound. In Japanese law, the distinction between {私文書|しぶんしょ} and ⟦{公文書|こうぶんしょ}→公文書：11677_koubunsho⟧ (public/official document) is significant — {公文書偽造|こうぶんしょぎぞう} carries a heavier penalty than {私文書偽造|しぶんしょぎぞう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私文書偽造|しぶんしょぎぞう}: forgery of a private document
- {私文書|しぶんしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧: creation of a private document
- {私文書|しぶんしょ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{公文書|こうぶんしょ}→公文書：11677_koubunsho⟧: private and public documents

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公文書|こうぶんしょ}→公文書：11677_koubunsho⟧: public/official document, issued by a government body
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧: documents in general, without the legal private/public distinction
- ⟦{証書|しょうしょ}→証書：18959_shousho⟧: certificate or deed, a formal document attesting to something
